reason: The hypothesis relies on a chain of premises linking atomic size mismatch, lattice distortion, dislocation glide, and thermoelastic behavior. E1 supports the link between lattice distortion and plastic zone size, and E4 supports the role of lattice distortion in dislocation nucleation, but no cited evidence directly supports the effect of lattice distortion on thermoelastic properties or the effect of reducing atomic radius mismatch on yield strength. The cited evidence is thus partly supportive but leaves key premises unsubstantiated.
